The perks of being a zebra

As an Investec colleague, we want you to feel happy, healthy, balanced and fulfilled, at home or beyond. Here are the benefits you can expect:

Be healthy

Being healthy means taking care of yourself, your body and your lifestyle holistically. Eating healthily, keeping active, sleeping well and doing what makes you feel your best.

You will have access to excellent healthcare choices, including private medical insurance, 24-hour GP access, onsite physiotherapists (in London), wellbeing subsidy, dental plans, income protection and regular eye tests.

Be present

Being present means taking care of your mental wellbeing, so you feel empowered to realise your potential and able to cope with the stresses of life.

We have onsite and telephone-based clinical psychologists, as well as a professional and a confidential 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme that is always there to help.

Be you

Being you means bringing your whole self to work. Balancing and integrating your personal, family, financial and work life to create greater harmony and connection.

To ensure you feel valued and rewarded, we will support you with an attractive salary and bonus scheme. We also offer a generous pension scheme, and independent free pension and mortgage advice. Should the worst happen, we also offer a death-in-service benefit.

Also, to support you and your loved ones through the many life stages, we offer generous parental and dependant’s leave policies, and a series of events and activities to help you navigate life changes.

Annual leave starts at 25 days and increases the longer you stay with us. We also offer part-time and flexible working options when possible.

Be connected

Being connected means taking care of and feeling connected to your social wellbeing. It’s a sense of belonging, purpose and relationship in the workplace, your local community and your environment.

If you’re passionate about contributing to the community, you’re in the right place. Here you can take up to two paid days a year to work with our community partners. We also arrange fun and meaningful volunteering opportunities throughout the year.

You can also join one of the many networks at Investec, such as the award-winning group of environmental champions, Team Green, and our diversity and inclusion networks - Gender Balance, LGBTQ+, Multicultural, YoungMinds, Working Parents and Ability.

We also recognise the commitment and loyalty of our colleagues with referral schemes and long-service awards.


  

Our approach to belonging, inclusion and diversity

In a high-performance culture, everyone must be able to participate freely. We work to create an environment where it’s easy for people to be themselves. It’s a responsibility we all share.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We offer all of our people opportunities for progression within our organisation. We are committed to inclusive practices through a range of networks, initiatives and learning opportunities. Our culture is one of honest conversations.

Investec career stories
Lucas Hunt

Lucas Hunt joined Investec in 2022 through the Summer Internship Programme and returned as an analyst in the Fund Solutions team in 2023 after completing his degree in Mechanical Engineering. The team provides innovative financing solutions to private market funds across the UK and Europe.

“Coming back to Investec full‑time has been an incredible start to my career. I’ve been able to work on high‑impact, complex transactions from day one, while building strong technical and commercial skills in a rapidly growing area of the alternatives market. What I value most is the culture here - the team encourages fresh thinking, backs you to take ownership, and gives you the space to make a real contribution from the outset.”

Arjun Chopra

Arjun Chopra joined Investec more than 14 years ago on our very first graduate programme and now heads up our Private Capital team, which lends money to high-net-worth individuals, business owners and entrepreneurs. During that time he’s worked in different teams, and in different countries, including India.

He says: “Being able to move around and learn new skills at Investec has given me different perspectives to draw on. People’s vision often starts to get broader as they spend more time here and it drives entrepreneurial thinking. From day one I’ve never felt restricted or unable to have a point of view.”

Channon Allen-Gulley

Channon Allen-Gulley joined Investec in 2016, starting in an entry‑level operations role where she spent two years strengthening her banking foundations before moving into private banking. Over the past six years, she’s developed significant expertise supporting high‑net‑worth clients in hedge funds and private equity across daily banking, lending and long‑term planning.

She credits Investec’s open, mobile and mentoring‑led culture for her progression, from backing her qualifications to the guidance she’s received from senior colleagues. Channon says that support has shaped her confidence: “Investec gives you the space to grow, learn and carve out your own path, no matter where you start.”

Our story

Committed to excellence for seven generations

Our approach to our people, like our approach to our clients, is informed by the Rothschild family's motto Concordia Integritas Industria, and over 200 years of experience.

From the founding of Mayer Amschel Rothschild's business in the 1760s to today, we have understood that close collaboration, trusted relationships and detailed local market knowledge are key to our success. 

Throughout two centuries of entrepreneurship we have never been content with conventional wisdom. As we look to the future, we take the time to understand our clients so we can continually innovate to meet their needs.

A strong and distinct culture, with a long-term approach to colleague development

We are, at our core, a family-owned business. The enduring role of the family has a lasting influence on our culture. We place great emphasis on integrity and doing the right thing, on building trust, treating others fairly and holding ourselves and each other accountable for our decisions and what we do.

Teamwork has always been fundamental to our approach. By collaborating within and across teams, we can bring the combined strength and breadth of our abilities to bear on our clients’ challenges.

To support the diverse range of clients we work with across the world effectively, we build teams with a broad mix of backgrounds, skills and experience. We take pride in a workplace where everyone feels welcome, included and respected.

We provide a broad range of learning opportunities that support individuals in building new skills and increasing knowledge at every stage of their careers, including mentoring and wellbeing support. We recognise that there is no one-size fits-all approach to career development.

Your move.

This is your opportunity to join a global team that sees the world diﬀerently. Where curious minds come together to take on some of the greatest, most complex challenges in global markets. We’re driven by a simple belief: that there’s a better ﬁnancial system out there – one where markets are a force for good, and investing can work for everyone.

From day one, you’ll do work that matters. You’ll ﬁnd your place here and contribute to impactful work that makes a real diﬀerence across the world. We know the decisions we make today shape the impact we have tomorrow. That’s why we’re relentless about innovation and ﬁnding smarter ways of doing things.

We’re building a team of people who aren’t afraid to think diﬀerently. Who see the whole picture. And know that high performance isn’t possible without support. You’ll be surrounded by leaders and colleagues who are both inspired by your potential and invested in your growth.

In turn, you’ll be focused on helping our clients achieve their goals, at scale. Because while individuals make changes, it’s together that we create real change.

Are you ready to move forward?

Our programmes
Apprenticeship Programme

Our Apprenticeship Programme is your chance to kick-start a career at BlackRock. Designed for school leavers, this 18-month training contract in Edinburgh or London offers hands-on experience in one of our business areas. From day one, you’ll be part of a team, learning how we work and contributing to meaningful projects. Throughout the programme, you’ll receive ongoing training and professional development to help you grow. Complete the programme successfully, and you could secure a full-time role with us – opening the door to an exciting future at BlackRock.

Full-Time Analyst Programme

Join our two-year Analyst Programme and do work that matters. You’ll learn by doing, collaborate globally and help millions achieve financial well-being – all with the support of mentors who invest in your growth.

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between June 2026 and July 2027, with fluency in English and the local language – except for Budapest and Investment roles in Zurich

Learn more and apply

Client & Product Graduate Rotational Programme

Our 2.5-year graduate programme offers rotations across Global Product Solutions and Client Business – the core engines of BlackRock’s client and product strategy. You’ll gain hands-on experience across the full client and product lifecycle, supported by structured learning, mentorship and meaningful projects, all designed to give you a comprehensive understanding of how we deliver investment solutions to meet clients’ evolving needs worldwide.

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating by July 2027, fluency in English and the local language

Learn more and apply

Summer Internship Programme

Our eight-week Summer Internship (from June to August) gives you a real taste of life at BlackRock. You’ll work with a team, join conversations with leaders and connect with mentors – all while building skills that shape your future.  

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating in 2028, with fluency in English and the local language – except for Budapest and Investment roles in Zurich

Learn more and apply

Client & Product Summer Internship Programme

Our Client & Product Summer Internship Programme is an eight-week experience that gives you a real insight into life as a BlackRock Analyst. You’ll work with Global Product Solutions and Global Client Business, join thought-provoking sessions with senior leaders, connect with mentors and take part in events that help you build relationships across the firm and with fellow interns.

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating in 2028

Learn more and apply

Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme

Our Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme is an immersive eight‑week experience in the UK that offers a clear window into life as a BlackRock Associate. Designed for specialised master’s students in quantitative fields, the programme gives you hands‑on exposure to our work, our people and the impact you can make.

Eligibility: Students enrolled in analytics, computer science, engineering, mathematics or another quantitative‑focused master’s programme and graduating between August 2027 and July 2028, with at least one year of relevant work experience

Off-Cycle Internship Programme

Our six‑month Off‑Cycle Internship Programme gives you a close look at life as a BlackRock Analyst. You’ll work side by side with one of our teams, gaining hands‑on experience as you explore how our work shapes markets, clients and communities. Along the way, you’ll build skills that matter, develop industry insight and form connections that can guide your next move – all while making a meaningful impact from day one.

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between July 2027 and 2028, with fluency in English and the local language – except for Budapest and Investment roles in Zurich

Learn more and apply

Client & Product Off-Cycle Internship Programme

Our six‑month Client & Product Off‑Cycle Internship gives you hands‑on experience across Global Product Solutions and Global Client Business, helping you understand how we design and deliver solutions for clients worldwide. You’ll build commercial skills, learn from teams who think differently and form connections that support your growth while making an impact from day one.

Eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between July 2027 and 2028, with fluency in English and the local language

Placement Programme

Our 12‑Month Placement Programme gives you the chance to experience life at BlackRock while taking on real responsibility from day one. You’ll contribute to work that helps us meet the evolving needs of our clients, all while developing new skills and building a strong foundation for your future career.

Eligibility: Undergraduate students whose degree requires a long‑term internship and who are graduating in 2029

From day one, you’ll be part of a team, learning how we work and contributing to meaningful projects. Throughout the programme, you’ll receive ongoing training and professional development to help you grow. Complete the programme successfully, and you could secure a full-time role with us – opening the door to an exciting future at BlackRock.

Who we are

We’re different. Being a global investment manager with an emerging market heritage influences our approach. We bring a special perspective to active investing, which lets us find opportunities for clients in all kinds of places.

Find out more about us

Our culture

The culture of Ninety One reflects who we are as people. It is our shared values and norms that make us.

We believe the strength of our culture is a competitive advantage, ensuring a healthy environment for debate. This is the foundation for our pursuit of enduring investment performance and outstanding client service. Above all, our culture embodies our overriding value – to do the right thing.

 
“At the heart of everything that we talk about in terms of the culture, is do the right thing”
Duncan Coombe, Global Head of Human Capital

Why we might be right for you

We believe in recognising individual talents, strengths and ambitions and support our people to reach their full potential, we do not box people into job titles. We are open minded to people expanding their roles, moving jobs and changing their career paths. We believe it is this constant opportunity for new challenges that has resulted in our people staying with us for the long-term.

 
“Ultimately, it’s about a human experience”
Khadeeja Bassier, Chief Operating Officer
Diversity and belonging
We have a genuine approach to diversity and belonging

True to our heritage, Ninety One is committed to creating an environment rich in diversity; an environment where our demographics increasingly reflect society and our client base; where all people feel welcome and respected; where all people have a fair opportunity to develop and contribute. We articulate our philosophy under 5 pillars:

Commitment to diversity

Our commitment is to nurture diversity that reflects society and our clients. We provide equal opportunities in an environment where respect and acceptance are key.

	
Integration with culture

Our core values, “do the right thing” and “freedom to create,” incorporate our diversity initiatives, giving us a distinctive competitive edge.

	
Emphasis on freedom

Our approach to diversity and belonging emphasizes individual freedom to express, seize opportunities, and realize potential. We do not assume a level playing field.

	
Shared responsibility

We believe diversity and belonging are collective obligations. Both the organization and individuals are held accountable to counter prejudice, discrimination, and mistreatment.

	
Culture of inclusion and belonging

We drive value by appreciating differences and by creating a culture that fosters individual expression and belonging. This leads to collaboration and superior outcomes for our clients.

Belong is a grassroots employee-led network focused on the recruitment, retention and representation of black talent. The network has set out to create a further-enhanced inclusive environment where black professionals can thrive in an equal-opportunity environment.

	

Inspire is a network created by women for women at Ninety One. It enables the exchange of knowledge and experiences in order to improve the opportunities for career success. Inspire plays an important role in helping us make our firm a more inclusive place.

	

Proud is our LGBTQ+ network which is designed to create an internal community for our LGBTQ+ colleagues and their allies. We aim to promote an inclusive and supportive work environment, where people who identify as LGBTQ+ are free to be themselves.
